name: wwp-film-workflow
description: Repo-local Codex skills and helpers for WWP film and series production workflows.

interface.shortDescription: Route WWP intake, metadata, playable video, Notion, and Media Assets work.
interface.longDescription: Project-local Codex workflow rules for explicit human/AI handoffs, ingesting new resources, preventing duplicate works, maintaining metadata-first catalog entries, selecting films and series, creating work/spec pages early, encoding playable MP4 variants, publishing to Notion, writing Media Assets, backfilling manual uploads, handling source archives, and filling structured film metadata through identity, Douban, OMDb, TMDb, and AI advisory lanes.
interface.defaultPrompt: When the user says 开始制作影视库, run the complete WWP workflow from registered input roots through metadata, playable production, Notion publishing, Media Assets, and final readback verification.
